_comment: Mill Table design tokens (M10 U2, AGT-65): one place for the table's colours, the look of each kind of line, and the word each state carries, so NO_COLOR loses nothing. The Ink seat reads it (game/src/ui/palette.ts); the SwiftUI design system (demo/swiftui-design-system) names the same accents as its *-text tokens. Night is a dark ground, Day a light one; ansi is the 16-colour name, so the user's terminal theme decides the shade.

rust.meaning: action and danger: your turn, bloodied, down

teal.meaning: recovery: healing, a rest, an ally back up

hint.meaning: secondary text: engine lines, status, labels
